title: Detailed sushi roll
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- plate shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='36' ry='10' fill='#1a3a5c'/>
  <!-- plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#e8e0d0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='30' ry='7' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <!-- nori outer ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='28' ry='26' fill='#2d4a3e'/>
  <!-- nori texture highlights -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='27' ry='25' fill='#1e3a2e'/>
  <!-- rice ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='23' ry='21' fill='#f8f4e8'/>
  <!-- rice grain dots -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='42' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#eee8d8'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='36' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#eee8d8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='52' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#eee8d8'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='60' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='54' r='1.5' fill='#eee8d8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='64' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#eee8d8'/>
  <!-- inner filling area -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='15' ry='14' fill='#f0e8d0'/>
  <!-- salmon -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='47' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#ff8c5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='47' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffaa7a'/>
  <!-- salmon stripes -->
  <path d='M39 47 Q43 43 46 44' stroke='#ff7040' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M48 43 Q51 45 53 48' stroke='#ff7040' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M40 50 Q44 51 48 50' stroke='#ff7040' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- avocado -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='50' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#7ab648'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='50' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#9ed468'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='50' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#c8e8a0'/>
  <!-- cucumber -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='55' r='3.5' fill='#3d8b37'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='55' r='2.2' fill='#b8e8a8'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='55' r='1' fill='#7ab648'/>
  <!-- crab stick -->
  <rect x='52' y='43' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ff5050'/>
  <rect x='52' y='43' width='8' height='1.2' rx='0.6' fill='#ff8080'/>
  <!-- sesame seeds on top -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='32' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#f0e0b0' transform='rotate(-20 40 32)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='34' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#f0e0b0' transform='rotate(15 58 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='28' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#f0e0b0' transform='rotate(5 50 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='40' rx='1.2' ry='0.8' fill='#f0e0b0' transform='rotate(-30 35 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='45' rx='1.2' ry='0.8' fill='#f0e0b0' transform='rotate(40 66 45)'/>
  <!-- wasabi blob -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='62' r='5' fill='#88cc44'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='62' r='3.5' fill='#a8e060'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='62' r='1.8' fill='#c8f080'/>
  <!-- ginger slices -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='66' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ffaaaa' transform='rotate(-15 28 66)'/>
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='69' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ffc0c0' transform='rotate(10 31 69)'/>
  <!-- soy sauce dish -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='74' rx='10' ry='4' fill='#d0c8b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='73' rx='8' ry='3' fill='#3a1a0a'/>
  <ellipse cx='77' cy='72.5' rx='4' ry='1.5' fill='#5a2a10'/>
</svg>
